name: Human Activity Recognition Using Smartphones
description: The Human Activity Recognition database was built from the recordings of 30 volunteers performing six daily activities (Walking, Walking Upstairs, Walking Downstairs, Sitting, Standing, Laying) carrying a waist-mounted Samsung Galaxy S II smartphone with embedded 3-axial accelerometer and gyroscope sensors at 50Hz.
